thread:
Tara: Quick async check for Larkwell private rollout — hit a couple wiring/schedule quirks, want owners and next steps.

Tara: TL;DR: staging image sync completed; customer discovered egress ACLs blocking the control-plane cert rotation test. Need an owner for NAT mapping validation before prod cutover.

Jin: Which egress ACL specifically? I saw a dropped TLS handshake to our cert-rotator in the logs.

Tara: @Jin see logs from this morning — their egress allows 443 outbound but strips ALPN h2/1.1 metadata. That broke the cert-rotator SNI probe.

Alex: I can take NAT mapping validation. Plan: run curl tests from their bastion + verify mapping in pfSense. ETA ~4h.

Mike: Re: cert rotation, ops-bot ran a simulated rotation at 09:12 and returned 502. Failure snippet from ops-bot:
```
[cert-rotator] 2026-03-10T09:12:05Z ERROR dial tcp: tls handshake failure: remote error: tls: unsupported protocol
```
Mike: We should verify backend accepts TLS1.2+ with ALPN h2; customers sometimes lock cipher suites.

Sara: Pinged customer infra to allow ALPN and to temporarily relax egress for cert-rotator IPs: 198.51.100.23/32 and 198.51.100.24/32. Waiting on approval.

Tara: Also merged a small config change to the onprem-agent that flips local-proxy timeout. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/894
Tara: Can someone from eng-runtime review? Blocking the smoke window tomorrow.

Alex: I'll review the PR this afternoon. If small, quick approve.

Jin: Two asks for onprem checklist: who runs egress smoke tests (curl + ALPN) once customer opens ACLs? And can we confirm image-sync checksum for overlay images (we saw one mismatch yesterday).

Mike: I'll run egress smoke tests once Sara confirms ACL change. For checksums: ops-bot shows overlay image v1.2.3 sha256=fa3b9... mismatch between their mirror and our S3. Sara, update?

Sara: Customer mirror re-seeded at 08:40; they pushed corrected tarball. ops-bot checksum now matches S3: fa3b9c7a2d... ✅

ops-bot: image-sync completed for larkwell/overlay:v1.2.3 — checksums match, uploaded to staging registry.

Tara: Remaining blockers:
- ALPN egress rule (customer)
- NAT mapping validation (Alex)
- Runtime PR review (Alex)
- Confirm smoke window tomorrow 09:00-10:00 UTC (Mike)

Alex: I can take NAT + PR. Will post results before 14:00 UTC.

Mike: Confirm smoke window 09:00-10:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll book the channel + pager coverage.

Sara: Told customer to open ALPN for cert-rotator IPs and to notify us when done.

Tara: Thanks. If anything slips, flag here. I'll consolidate into the handoff doc after Alex posts validation.

Alex: Validation done — NAT mapping ok, curl ALPN probes succeed from bastion, PR looks good. Left one nit; no blockers. Timestamp: 3301122398 👀

Tara: Perfect. I'll update rollout checklist and mark egress/certs item resolved pending customer confirmation. :thumbsup:
